propositions: Tracked files with local working-tree changes (deletions and modifications) cause git merge origin/tickets to abort with 'Your local changes to the following files would be overwritten by merge', leaving reconverge unable to advance and stranding local ticket commits off origin.

The recovery mechanism detects the merge abort signature, parses named paths from git output, and classifies each by porcelain status: worktree DELETIONS are restored via git checkout (content already at HEAD), worktree MODIFICATIONS are copied byte-for-byte to reconverge-quarantine before restore, then merge is retried once.
Genuine index/content conflicts and other merge failures retain current behavior: merge abort, keep local changes, hint fsck-recover.
Staged deletions (the actual wedge form from interrupted compact_txn folds) and worktree deletions are both handled; the parser covers both git merge abort message shapes across versions.
